{{Quote|It's a dangerous region--impossible to safely navigate.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="Maelstrom" />}}
The '''Maelstrom Nebula''', also simply as '''the Maelstrom''', was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
The Maelstrom Nebula was a huge [[Color/Legends|green]] cloud of charged space dust and raw energy which altered navigation coordinates and fuddled [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]].<ref name="RM" /> The [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] was located on the borders of the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio]] and [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]],<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> and the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]] ran through it, forcing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on the run to exit [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and navigate through the cloud at [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] speed. This created opportunities for the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Big Jak Targrim]], to raid starliners.<ref name="RM" />

==History==
{{Quote|A Jedi prisoner possessing vital information is held captive there. I need your help to navigate the Maelstrom Nebula and free him.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="Maelstrom" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]], the Maelstrom served as a important location for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Empire hid a [[Maelstrom Prison|space station]] in the Maelstrom, where the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] imprisoned [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] for over 300 years before he was [[Battle of the Maelstrom|freed]].<ref name="Maelstrom" />

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer [[Rodin Higron]] also began raiding ships along the run, the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] governing Albarrio and Relgim sectors, [[Vanko]] and [[Torpin]] respectively, decided to act in concert to destroy the pirates.<ref name="RM" />
